description: This Java source file defines the PickListServices class, providing services related to picklist operations in the OFBiz framework, including converting order ID lists to headers and checking if a picklist bin is complete.

classes.name: PickListServices
classes.description: Provides static methods for handling picklist-related services such as converting order IDs to headers and checking bin completion status.

methods.name: convertOrderIdListToHeaders
methods.description: Converts a list of order IDs into order header records, filtering for approved sales orders, and returns the list along with success status.

methods.name: isBinComplete
methods.description: Checks whether all items in a picklist bin are completed or canceled, returning true if complete, false otherwise.
